mathematical_reconstruction_checks.detail: Both sign regimes work on the submitted degree-at-one-endpoint class. Conditioning on colors1/2 leaves no external field. Nonzero interactions fit by interior/cap KKT; two active incident fits force equal interactions since distinct neighbors can differ under full support. Their common conditional max/min controls the remaining zero edge. Global color symmetry recovers the entire table. The reverse-KL inequality uses D(mu_previous||mu_next), not its reversal. Endpoints use finite compactness with a positive reference.

The residual bound genuinely uses marked-vertex leaf cancellation: a surviving marked-edge forest is one path, and the alternative path has at least g-1 edges. The seed is not assumed to fit. A full unary/pair gauge realizes the exact target only after the interior minimum is constructed. The logarithmic partition gain is order rho^g and the fitting correction order rho^(2g-2); every stated smallness constant pays a named side condition. No global conclusion survives after dropping the radius.

Strictness is supplied by positive-probability alternate-path two-color events, not merely by weak correlations. The positive-definite covariance is checked by distinct simple-edge Walsh monomials, and the full-table inverse uses a fixed feature basis while kappa varies. The repaired analytic-family interval avoids antiferromagnetic fits on nonbipartite graphs. At independence the gap is zero; at s=0 or1 the base has zero support; neither admits this openness argument. The q>=3 triple extension is explicitly separate from q=2 feasibility.

Identity-tree contraction leaves originalmu, not a tilted measure. Extra identity-cycle factors and S loops are at least1, so deletion is a valid lower bound. Four quotient vertices have the standard five core types; three have18 multiplicity triples; two have at most4 parallel edges. Dense quotient bounds use R=S Hadamard S with ordinary operator R² and traces of only two PSD factors. Each power's common-cone coefficients are nonnegative by a finite geometric-sum inequality. An additional zero complement when x,y>0 is a THIRD centered level and is not covered.

Disjoint-support component likelihood ratios give exactly (n_C-1)H(pi)+sum pi_i KL_i,C, including isolated vertices; the pair cost is H(pi)+sum pi_i I_i. Thus the beta H(pi) surplus is conditional on the stated within-block witnesses. The IID mixture chain rule has the correct lower-bound orientation. In the actual K3,3-minus-edge example, every oriented-edge correction is exactly D and all other terms vanish by centered endpoint integration. The mixed/no-color1/all-color1 trichotomy supplies nonnegativity on all729 configurations: bridgeless cuts pay the mixed case and the bounded Potts mass floor pays the other cases. Both finite TV bounds lie in the entropy-continuity monotone ranges, and rational/log estimates give slack strictly greater than229/540. This is an explicit mechanism on a previously known Sidorenko graph, not a new universally covered graph or a proof of the unrestricted input target.

Left and right composition by symmetric Markov kernels average relative to the SAME originalmu; identity endpoints introduce no kernel-norm penalty in composition. Telescoping gives ||T^s-T0^s||infinity<=s epsilon and then the exact six-factor estimate2N epsilon(M0+epsilon)^5. Positive all-I/all-A buffers are valid in the two cases y>0 andy0, with N>=6 and non-IID exclusions. The explicit20-state three-band perturbation is an actual positive Markov root; its density/mixing checks and conditional-expectation hierarchy exclusion are consistent. Coverage is local in the fixed host and six-exponent tuple, not uniform spectral compensation.

For the actual ordered tuple(k,r+h,u,r,u,l) withh>0, Im-Li-Liu Thm1.4 on baseK4 requires every length multiplicity divisible by6; with six single paths that forces all lengths equal, incompatible withr+h versusr. Their Thm1.6 exceptional-vertex family requires three equal incident lengths and three equal opposite lengths. At vertexc, r+h differs fromr; at verticesa,b,d the two triples' equality constraints again forceh0. Thus those exact nearby conclusions are not a supplied proof of this universal ordered tuple. This is a hypothesis comparison only, not an exhaustive novelty or literature certification.
